agent.name: Organizational Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Organizational readiness to absorb govern and sustain a specified application

analytical_question: Given fictional scoped learning authorization and prepared operating controls, what changes in organizational readiness for an isolated chart-review PoC versus sustained routine release?
general_et_finding: Agentic AI here combines a language model, model-selected tools, observations, permissions and human stopping authority for bounded multistep work; it is not equivalent to a standalone model or chart plugin. Organizational adoption requires named oversight, competent reviewers, controlled inputs and tools, reliable handoffs, incident response and continuing support. NIST AI RMF 1.0 (S1) and GenAI Profile (S2) offer voluntary governance and monitoring practices, not certification, company evidence or legal rules. The C3 implementation framework distinguishes a feasibility proof of concept, subsequent comparative value evidence and organizational acceptance. General system characteristics and application feasibility remain unchanged between these profiles; organizational capacity changes what can responsibly be attempted.
application_finding: For supervised chart review, a bounded agent would use read-only tools to compare chart labels, denominators, visual encodings and written claims against approved source tables, then provide traceable draft corrections to a named human reviewer. The reviewer must independently verify source lineage and interpretation and explicitly sign off before publication; the agent never publishes or makes financial/customer decisions. A feasibility PoC would test whether the read-only chain, provenance, error capture and stopping controls function on public/synthetic examples. A separate matched comparison against current manual/deterministic review would then be necessary to determine accuracy, severe-error incidence, reviewer effort, total support burden and incremental net benefit. Neither case supplies these performance or value outcomes; technology/application fit remains UNVALIDATED and comparative net advantage UNKNOWN.
organization_specific_finding: Overall judgment: conditionally PREPARED for the explicitly scoped, hypothetical four-week learning PoC; NOT QUALIFIED for routine deployment. This contrast modifies organizational evidence only, not technology maturity, accuracy, net advantage or the actual real-world authorization. Eight domains: (1) Leadership/sponsorship—a named-role reporting sponsor signs the fictional charter and accepts accountability for learning scope; routine-release sponsorship is not granted. (2) Skills/training—two BI reviewers have recorded source-trace and error-escalation competency checks, including ordinary users; this is not agent-performance validation. (3) Workflow/process—a dry run records task handoff, reviewer publication sign-off, exception queue and manual fallback; sustained real-operation reliability remains unmeasured. (4) Infrastructure/data—security has confirmed sandbox isolation, approved model/tool route, least-privilege read-only access, lineage and test logs for public/synthetic inputs only, not production qualification. (5) Resources/budget—protected time for reviewers and maintainer fits a confirmed total 24-hour PoC cap; a funded next-quarter support line has a review date, but actual cost and adequacy remain unknown. (6) Governance/risk—risk owner signs access, incident and change controls; a stopping/escalation/manual-restore exercise is recorded. (7) Culture/change—analyst representatives reviewed workload, agreed to participate, and have documented dissent and nonpunitive reporting; this does not measure long-run acceptance. (8) Operating ownership—a reporting service owner and deputy agree duty/cover and stop authority, with monthly review assigned. All are fictional profile premises; none proves routine operations or successful chart corrections.

evidence.claim: Specific learning approval, sponsor, deputy, training, capped capacity, controls and participation are stipulated
evidence.notes: Apply solely to this case; not independently verified firm activity.

evidence.claim: No routine-use permission or performance evidence accompanies fictional readiness
evidence.notes: Authorization is only one isolated synthetic/public, read-only PoC.

evidence.claim: Current team baseline remains DEFER outside this hypothetical contrast
evidence.notes: A fictional approval premise does not amend real-world team disposition.

evidence.claim: Feasibility PoC, value trial and organizational acceptance must remain distinct
evidence.notes: No PoC, value trial or acceptance study has actually run.

evidence.claim: Training, assigned roles, monitoring and recovery are appropriate safeguards
evidence.source_or_reference: S1 NIST AI 100-1; S2 NIST AI 600-1
evidence.notes: Do not infer legal compliance or software qualification.

evidence.claim: Eight-domain organizational readiness review is required
evidence.notes: Not a scored assessment or company certification.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The prepared profile is deliberately fictional, not a report of an actual trial, security approval or trained staff.
The 24-hour cap is an approved hypothetical capacity boundary, not evidence of adequate workload or a benefit measurement.
Representative accuracy, severe-error behavior, comparative net advantage and production data/model approval remain unknown.
Positive control H2 in T1 is an assumption; it is not independent readiness evidence or permission for this profile.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence that the stipulated profile addresses the eight organizational gates for a narrow learning exercise. Moderate confidence that its rehearsed controls would support an orderly hypothetical PoC within the cap; exercise evidence is not evidence of reliability under workload. Low confidence in application feasibility, savings, reliability over a quarter and readiness for release. A single ordinal or numerical score would falsely combine these distinct questions.
value_opportunity_implication: Prepared staffing and controls make it possible, within the fictional boundary, to collect credible feasibility observations instead of guessing. That does not establish value. If an authorized PoC were conducted, preserve matched manual/deterministic comparators and explicitly capture reviewer checks, maintainer effort, corrections accepted/rejected, false claims, serious errors and total cost. A subsequent value trial and organizational acceptance review require separate approval.
risk_governance_implication: Treat the fictional access approval as restricted to public/synthetic examples and read-only tools. Enforce logs and provenance, reviewer veto, independent sign-off, stop/escalation routing and tested manual fallback; do not permit routine publication, production connectivity or sensitive data. The reporting service owner and deputy handle day-to-day operations; risk/security owners retain approval and incident governance. Monthly capacity/cost/incident review is stipulated but effectiveness remains unobserved.
recommendation_management_implication: For this prepared-profile thought experiment, the organization may be judged ready to ENTER a separately authorized, four-week bounded feasibility PoC, not adopt the application routinely; no test is executed in this response. Conditional use case: select public/synthetic business charts with known source tables, intentionally including denominator, labeling and unsupported-claim challenges. Purpose is to determine whether read-only tools and supervised corrections preserve traceability and stopping controls. Roles: sponsor owns charter and scope; service owner/deputy coordinate; two BI reviewers independently check outputs and sign off on any internal exercise artifact; maintainer handles sandbox/logs; risk/security confirm permissions and incident actions; finance monitors the 24-hour cap. Gate before execution is confirmation that fictional approval and safeguards apply to the actual proposed test, benchmark cases and staff schedule, with explicit abort authority. Measures include source-link completeness, factual/visual discrepancies, severe failure counts, human overrides, review effort, support time, incident handling and manual fallback. Stop if the cap is reached, provenance is lost, unauthorized access occurs, a material misleading claim escapes review, staff cannot review, or rollback fails. Review at four weeks for feasibility only; commission a separate matched value/acceptance evaluation before any routine decision. Real primary-case DEFER remains unaffected.
change_monitoring_triggers: At each exercise gate, verify that actual authority and sandbox/data bounds match the fictional scenario; otherwise retain DEFER.
Stop on cap exhaustion, provenance breach, unsafe output handling, unresolved serious errors or loss of reviewer/backup coverage.
Monthly and next-quarter reviews should revisit funded support, incidents, staff acceptance and model/data changes; routine operation requires new evidence and approval.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Representative chart-agent performance, baseline-relative error rates and total human/platform cost are missing.
Evidence that controls sustain under actual recurring workloads and broader user acceptance is missing.
Production model/data qualification, sensitive-data access and routine publication authority are explicitly not supplied.
